why_wrong: Fractional-N Divider Accumulator Flow: hardcodes all outputs to zero so there are no fb edges and the edge-count checks fail.
Fractional-N Divider Accumulator Flow: drives lock high unconditionally so it never drops during the reference disturbance and the disturb-low fraction check fails.
Fractional-N Divider Accumulator Flow: compares div_cnt >= div_target+1 so the integer divide is one too large and the late fb cadence diverges.
Fractional-N Divider Accumulator Flow: resets vctrl to init on every ref edge so the loop never corrects and vctrl does not move during reacquire.

Fractional-N Divider Accumulator Flow: overrides frac_word_eff to a different legal fraction word (6 instead of 3) so the effective average ratio shifts from div_int - 3/acc_modulus to div_int - 6/acc_modulus; the late-window DCO-to-fb divide ratio no longer matches the expected 7.625 and the fractional-ratio checker fails.
